_comment: The index checkout's manifest, and deliberately thin. It owns NO dependencies: each mounted instance declares what its own code imports in its own package.json, and `workspaces` lets one install resolve them all (each instance sees only what it declares). It keeps only the scripts that compose more than one instance -- the bootstrap aliases and the SMART IG pages, which run fhir-harness or cat-harness tooling over a mounted WHO instance and so belong to no single layer (fhir-harness must stay WHO-free) -- plus `cat`, which finds every other script in the instances' `checkoutScripts` (cat-harness/schemas/script-table.ts: 'the root keeps only the few'). The SMART entries lived in smart-*/package.json until the SMART cutover, whose mounts carry declared directories only, so they had no home; an entry moves out of here the moment its instance declares it again (smart-trust's did, in its own checkoutScripts), because a script declared twice stops `bun run cat` altogether.
name: @litlfred/folio-assistant-index

scripts.smart-base:pages: bun run fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts --instance smart-base --publish-note "This page mirrors a published WHO Implementation Guide." --sidecar-label "DAK API" --label "WHO SMART Base" --chrome-owner smart-base --summary
scripts.smart:pages: bun run cat smart-base:pages && bun run cat smart-trust:pages && bun run cat smart-immunizations:pages
